ask: quick P1 pass on the clinic prototype before my 2pm demo. desktop only
notes: Bar and width given, time pressure. Quick track (P1 only, no phone). A good intake asks one or two questions at most.
message:
I'm starting the product review loop on your clinic prototype. Here is the brief as I have it. Nothing has started yet.

## Brief

- **Goal:** a quick review of the whole prototype before your 2pm demo. The loop opens every screen, clicks the buttons, takes a screenshot of each screen, and checks for P1 problems (the ones that would hurt in front of people).
- **Prototype:** `proto-clinic/index.html` ("Northside Physio"). It is the only prototype in this folder. It opens as a file, so no server is needed.
- **Start check:** Node 25.9.0 and Google Chrome are both found, so the walk can run.
- **Screens found:** Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings (the four items in the nav).
- **Width:** desktop only (1440 px). You said so, so the phone-width check is switched off.
- **Bar:** P1 only. You said "quick P1 pass", so P2 and P3 problems are listed but not fixed.
- **Rules:** the built-in checklist. I found no `CLAUDE.md`, no `design-review` skill, no `product-design` skill and no earlier runs to add rules from.
- **Stop fact:** after the last walk, a fresh agent finds no open P1 on any of the 4 screens. Any P1 left for you to decide is listed first in `handover.md`.
- **Local only:** nothing is deployed, published or sent.

## Questions

1. **Which screens?** Default: all 4 the nav reaches: Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings. Tell me if there is a screen the nav does not reach (a dialog, a detail page) that you will show.
2. **Who uses it, and what one job do they come to do?** Default (a guess from the screens): "front-desk staff at a physio clinic who run the day's bookings, clients and invoices". The job is to see today's appointments and book a new one.
3. **Fix what I find, or only report it?** Default: fix, in place, keeping a copy of every changed file in the run folder. Say "report only" if you do not want the file touched before the demo.
4. **Any rule of your own to check?** Default: the built-in checklist only.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
